description: This file implements operations on a vector data structure used for handling segmentation and reassembly (SAR) payloads in a network protocol context. It includes functions for initialization, validation, appending payloads, serializing the vector, and cleanup.

methods.name: bool IsValidPayload(sar_vector_t * sarv,sar_payload_t * new_payload)
methods.description: Validates if a new SAR payload can be appended to the SAR vector based on session ID and sequence ID ordering.

methods.name: void SAR_VECTOR_Init(sar_vector_t * sarv)
methods.description: Initializes the SAR vector structure, setting all pointers to NULL and counters to zero.

methods.name: bool SAR_VECTOR_Append(sar_vector_t * sarv,uint64_t sess_id,uint64_t seq_id,uint8_t * data,int len)
methods.description: Appends a new payload to the SAR vector after validation, performing a deep copy of data.

methods.name: void SAR_VECTOR_Destroy(sar_vector_t * sarv)
methods.description: Deallocates all memory associated with the SAR vector, including each payload's data, and resets the vector.

methods.name: sar_payload_t * SAR_VECTOR_Get(sar_vector_t * sarv,unsigned index)
methods.description: Retrieves a pointer to the payload at a specified index in the SAR vector.

methods.name: uint8_t * SAR_VECTOR_Serialize(sar_vector_t * sarv,int * len)
methods.description: Serializes all payloads in the SAR vector into a contiguous buffer for transmission or storage.

ctags.name: SAR_VECTOR_Append
ctags.pattern: /^bool SAR_VECTOR_Append(sar_vector_t *sarv, uint64_t sess_id, uint64_t seq_id, uint8_t *data, int/
